text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the day of the Mile CS! I was 
so focused, I couldn't even see the other 
Umamusume around me...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, King's phoenix-like brilliance is 
utterly mesmerizing. Wait, I can't... I 
love her so much.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To think I might glimpse her abyss in this 
race... *drools*☆ Now then! Let us have a 
fair and square match!
